No group or government immediately claimed responsibility.The administration also emphasised that Libya was not involved in the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, seeking to distance the country from any suggestion that its territory was being used as a battleground in the ongoing war.Conflicting initial reports and investigationEarly accounts of the explosion suggested that a fire had erupted at an ammunition storage facility within a naval installation in Benghazi. stories.title: EU takes aim at tech giants in tax proposal
stories.summary: European Council President Antonio Costa has proposed a smaller EU budget for 2028-2034, including a 3% tax on major digital firms to ease member states' contributions. France has already rejected the plan as inadequate.

stories.title: Iran balances ties with China and Russia as Trump ramps up pressure
stories.summary: As Donald Trump seeks to tighten economic pressure on Iran, China remains its biggest oil customer and Russia a key partner. But both powers are balancing support for Tehran against broader interests with Washington.
stories.article_text_excerpt: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5PaQi Prefer DW on Google China and Russia back Iran but must balance that support against broader interests with Washington Image: Mandel Ngan/AFP Advertisement As Donald Trump , Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin meet in Shenzhen, Washington wants to tighten its blockade of Iran, but China remains Tehran's main oil buyer and Russia offers it political and logistical support. For Iran , relations with both China and Russia are routinely described as strategic. That relationship looks more complicated from Beijing and Moscow. Both countries oppose Washington's efforts to isolate Iran and maintain political and economic ties with Tehran . But both have broader interests in their relationships with the United States and may see Iran partly through the prism of their own negotiations with Washington. That raises a central question: Can Trump's strategy of economically isolating Iran succeed if China and Russia refuse to fully cooperate? stories.title: Strait of Hormuz: Athlete swims through war zone to expose war's environmental toll
stories.summary: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh completed a 15-kilometre swim through the Strait of Hormuz over three days in November 2026, braving explosions and burning tankers nearby. His three-day challenge aimed to expose the environmental damage caused by the war with Iran.
